item.text: {"program_id":"qtclustering_claude-fable-5.1-cc-medium_hybrid_r3","verdict":"invalid","issue_categories":["missing_rank_aggregation","rank_local_timing","missing_start_synchronization"],"confidence":"high","timed_region":"MPI_Barrier at qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp:1507, timer start at 1508, qtClustering at 1510, stop barrier at 1512, and timer stop at 1513-1515.","start_synchronization":"A barrier exists at line 1507, but each rank starts its local timer after independently returning from the barrier; simultaneous return is not guaranteed, so rank 0's start may follow relevant work on other ranks.","stop_synchronization":"The barrier at line 1512 ensures all ranks have returned from qtClustering before local stop timestamps are taken.","rank_aggregation":"No timing reduction is performed. MPI_Allreduce calls at lines 1218 and 1282 aggregate clustering selection, not elapsed durations.","reported_value":"Rank 0 prints its own duration_cast<milliseconds>(cluster_end - cluster_start) as Clustering time at qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp:1530-1531.","semantic_equivalence_basis":"This is cooperative distributed work, not independent complete-result replicas: seeds are partitioned round-robin among ranks at lines 1147-1149, global selection uses MPI_Allreduce at 1218 and 1282, and the winning member list is broadcast at 1297-1301.","evidence":[{"path":"qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","lines":"1147-1150","finding":"Each rank owns only a round-robin subset of candidate seeds."},{"path":"qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","lines":"1218-1219; 1282-1283","finding":"MPI collectives combine algorithmic best-cluster selections, but no elapsed-time values are reduced."},{"path":"qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","lines":"1507-1515","finding":"Each rank independently times qtClustering between post-barrier local timestamps; the start barrier does not establish simultaneous timer starts."},{"path":"qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","lines":"1530-1531","finding":"The canonical Clustering time is rank 0's local duration, not the global maximum or a proven global makespan."}],"timing_only_fix_possible":true,"minimal_fix":"Reduce each rank's completed local elapsed duration with MPI_MAX and have rank 0 print the reduced maximum; the clustering computation and timed boundaries can otherwise remain unchanged.","notes":"Validation runs only after timing and reporting at qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp:1566-1581, so validation success does not establish timer validity."}
